sport.en: My favorite sport is basketball because it is fun to play with friends.
sport.zh: 我最喜欢的体育运动是篮球，因为和朋友一起打很有趣。

jump.en: The rabbit can jump very high to reach the carrot on the table.
jump.zh: 兔子能跳得很高去够桌子上的胡萝卜。

high.en: The bird flies high in the sky and looks for food below.
high.zh: 鸟儿高高地飞在天空中，寻找下面的食物。

far.en: We walked far along the beach until we found a big shell.
far.zh: 我们沿着海滩走了很远，直到发现一个大贝壳。

ping-pong.en: After class, my brother and I play ping-pong in the garden.
ping-pong.zh: 下课后，我和弟弟在花园里打乒乓球。

volleyball.en: The girls play volleyball on the sand every Sunday morning.
volleyball.zh: 女孩们每个周日上午在沙滩上打排球。

across.en: The cat walked across the street very carefully to avoid cars.
across.zh: 猫小心翼翼地穿过街道，避开汽车。

hope.en: I hope you can come to my birthday party this Saturday.
hope.zh: 我希望你这个星期六能来参加我的生日派对。

lose.en: If you lose your keys, ask your mom for help to find them.
lose.zh: 如果你丢了钥匙，就请妈妈帮忙找。

because.en: She is happy because she got a new puppy from her parents.
because.zh: 她很高兴，因为父母送了她一只新小狗。

because of.en: The game was cancelled because of the heavy rain outside.
because of.zh: 因为外面下大雨，比赛取消了。

cancer.en: My grandpa beat cancer and now he is healthy again.
cancer.zh: 我爷爷战胜了癌症，现在又健康了。

money.en: I saved my pocket money to buy a new toy car.
money.zh: 我攒下零花钱买了一辆新玩具车。

hard.en: The math problem was hard, but I solved it with help.
hard.zh: 这道数学题很难，但我在帮助下解出来了。

kind.en: My kind teacher helped me carry my heavy bag.
kind.zh: 我友善的老师帮我拿沉重的书包。

keep.en: Please keep your desk clean every day.
keep.zh: 请每天保持你的书桌干净。

month.en: We will visit my grandma in another month.
month.zh: 再过一个月我们就要去看我奶奶。

ill.en: My friend was ill and stayed home from school.
ill.zh: 我的朋友生病了，没来上学待在家里。

year.en: This year my family went to the beach in summer.
year.zh: 今年夏天我们一家去了海滩。

remember.en: Remember to bring your umbrella when it rains.

fail.en: If you fail the test, you can try again next time.
fail.zh: 如果你考试没通过，下次可以再试。

give.en: I will give my old books to the library.
give.zh: 我要把我的旧书捐给图书馆。

give up.en: Never give up on your dream, even when it is hard.
give up.zh: 即使困难，也永远不要放弃你的梦想。

never.en: I never eat candy before dinner.

try.en: I will try to finish my homework before dinner.
try.zh: 我会努力在晚饭前完成作业。

try your best.en: In the race, you should try your best to win.
try your best.zh: 在比赛中，你应该尽最大努力去赢。

star.en: My sister is the star of the school play.
star.zh: 我姐姐是学校话剧的明星。

ability.en: His ability to solve puzzles is amazing.
ability.zh: 他解决谜题的能力很惊人。

player.en: The soccer player scored a goal in the game.
player.zh: 那位足球运动员在比赛中进了一球。

phew.en: Phew! I finally finished all my chores.
phew.zh: 唷！我终于做完了所有家务。

wash.en: Mom asked me to wash the apples before eating.
wash.zh: 妈妈让我在吃之前洗苹果。

dish.en: Please put the clean dish on the table.
dish.zh: 请把干净的盘子放在桌子上。

feed.en: I need to feed the cat before school every morning.
feed.zh: 我每天早上上学前要喂猫。

sweep.en: Can you help me sweep the kitchen floor?
sweep.zh: 你能帮我扫一下厨房地板吗？

floor.en: The puppy left muddy footprints on the floor.
floor.zh: 小狗在地板上留下了泥脚印。

rubbish.en: Don't throw rubbish on the ground in the park.
rubbish.zh: 不要在公园的地上扔垃圾。

chore.en: Washing the dishes is my least favorite chore.
chore.zh: 洗碗是我最不喜欢的家务活。

to-do list.en: I wrote five things on my to-do list for today.
to-do list.zh: 我在今天的待办清单上写了五件事。

may.en: May I go outside and play after I finish my homework?
may.zh: 我做完作业后可以出去玩吗？

outside.en: The cat likes to sit outside and watch the birds.
outside.zh: 那只猫喜欢坐在外面看鸟。

tidy.en: Please tidy your toys before dinner time.
tidy.zh: 请在晚饭前整理好你的玩具。

easy.en: This math problem is very easy for me to solve.
easy.zh: 这道数学题对我来说很容易解决。

clean.en: Mom asked me to clean the kitchen table after lunch.
clean.zh: 妈妈让我午饭后把厨房桌子擦干净。

woof.en: The dog said “woof” when I came home from school.
woof.zh: 我放学回家时，狗叫了一声“汪汪”。

job.en: My job today is to water the flowers in the garden.
job.zh: 我今天的任务是给花园里的花浇水。

Good job!.en: You finished all your homework—good job!
Good job!.zh: 你完成了所有作业——干得好！

dirty.en: My little brother got his shirt dirty with mud.
dirty.zh: 我弟弟把衬衫弄脏了，沾上了泥巴。

desk.en: I keep my pencils and books on my desk at home.
desk.zh: 我把铅笔和书都放在家里的书桌上。

wall.en: I painted a big red flower on the wall in my room.
wall.zh: 我在房间的墙上画了一朵大大的红花。

again.en: Please read the story again and find the answer.
again.zh: 请再读一遍故事并找到答案。

also.en: My sister can sing and also play the piano very well.
also.zh: 我姐姐会唱歌，还会弹钢琴弹得很好。

sunshine.en: The cat loves to sleep in the warm sunshine by the window.
sunshine.zh: 那只猫喜欢睡在窗边温暖的阳光里。

sometimes.en: Sometimes I help my mom cook dinner on weekends.
sometimes.zh: 有时我在周末帮妈妈做晚饭。

feel.en: I feel happy when I play with my friends in the park.
feel.zh: 当我和朋友在公园玩时，我感到开心。

tired.en: After running for a long time, Dad looked very tired.
tired.zh: 跑了很长时间后，爸爸看起来很累。

helpful.en: My teacher is always helpful when I have questions.
helpful.zh: 我有问题时，我的老师总是乐于助人。

warm.en: The sun will warm the cold ground after the rain.
warm.zh: 雨后太阳会让冰冷的地面温暖起来。

warm up.en: I do some stretches to warm up before playing soccer.
warm up.zh: 踢足球前我做些拉伸来热身。

water.en: Every morning I water the flowers in our garden.
water.zh: 每天早上我给花园里的花浇水。

yard.en: We played hide-and-seek in the big yard behind the house.
yard.zh: 我们在房子后面的大庭院里玩捉迷藏。

helper.en: My big brother is a great helper when I clean my room.
helper.zh: 我哥哥在我打扫房间时是个好帮手。

pick.en: We can pick some red apples from the tree today.
pick.zh: 今天我们可以从树上摘一些红苹果。

pig.en: The little pig likes to roll in the mud after eating.
pig.zh: 小猪吃完东西后喜欢在泥里打滚。

cow.en: The cow gives us fresh milk every morning on the farm.
cow.zh: 奶牛每天早上在农场给我们提供新鲜的牛奶。

cut.en: Please cut the paper into a star shape for the card.
cut.zh: 请把纸剪成星星形状做卡片。

grass.en: The dog loves to run and play on the soft green grass.
grass.zh: 狗喜欢在柔软的绿草地上跑着玩。

weather.en: The weather today is perfect for a picnic in the park.
weather.zh: 今天的天气非常适合在公园野餐。

sunny.en: We wear hats and sunglasses on a sunny day at the beach.
sunny.zh: 在阳光明媚的海滩日，我们戴帽子和太阳镜。

cloud.en: A white cloud looks like a fluffy sheep in the blue sky.
cloud.zh: 一朵白云在蓝天上看起来像一只毛茸茸的羊。

by.en: The bus goes by our school every morning at eight o'clock.
by.zh: 公交车每天早上八点经过我们学校。

cloudy.en: On a cloudy day, we stay inside and read storybooks.
cloudy.zh: 在多云的日子，我们待在室内读故事书。

wind.en: The strong wind blows my red kite high into the air.
wind.zh: 强风把我的红色风筝吹到高高的空中。

blow.en: The strong wind can blow my hat off my head.
blow.zh: 强风能把我的帽子从头上吹走。

windy.en: We cannot fly kites on a very windy day.
windy.zh: 在风很大的日子里我们不能放风筝。

rain.en: The rain makes the flowers grow tall and green.
rain.zh: 雨水让花儿长得又高又绿。

rainy.en: I like to read books on a rainy afternoon.
rainy.zh: 我喜欢在下雨的下午看书。

snow.en: The children love to play in the soft white snow.
snow.zh: 孩子们喜欢在柔软的白雪里玩耍。

any.en: Do you have any red pencils in your pencil case?
any.zh: 你的铅笔盒里有红色的铅笔吗？

fly.en: My dad helps me fly my new kite in the park.
fly.zh: 我爸爸帮我在公园里放我的新风筝。

snowstorm.en: A big snowstorm closed the school for two days.
snowstorm.zh: 一场大暴风雪让学校停课两天。

beach.en: We built a big sandcastle on the sunny beach.
beach.zh: 我们在阳光明媚的沙滩上建了一个大沙堡。

sea.en: The blue sea looks very beautiful from our hotel window.
sea.zh: 从我们酒店的窗户看出去，蓝色的大海非常美丽。

equator.en: Countries near the equator are very hot all year.
equator.zh: 赤道附近的国家全年都很热。

round.en: The Earth goes round the sun once every year.
round.zh: 地球每年绕太阳转一圈。

all year round.en: The park has flowers all year round.

quite.en: The movie was quite exciting for everyone.
quite.zh: 这部电影对每个人来说都非常激动人心。

join.en: Can I join your game after lunch?
join.zh: 午饭后我能加入你们的游戏吗？

season.en: My favorite season is summer because I can swim.
season.zh: 我最喜欢的季节是夏天，因为我可以游泳。

spring.en: Birds sing and flowers bloom in spring.
spring.zh: 春天鸟儿唱歌，花儿开放。

summer.en: We go to the beach every summer vacation.
summer.zh: 我们每个暑假都去海滩。

autumn.en: Leaves turn yellow and red in autumn.
autumn.zh: 秋天叶子变成黄色和红色。

winter.en: Children love to build snowmen in winter.
winter.zh: 孩子们喜欢在冬天堆雪人。

favourite.en: My favourite fruit is the sweet strawberry.
favourite.zh: 我最喜欢的水果是甜草莓。

birthday.en: She got a new bike for her birthday.
birthday.zh: 她生日得到了一辆新自行车。

bus.en: The yellow bus takes us to school every day.
bus.zh: 黄色公交车每天送我们去学校。

car.en: My dad drives a red car to work.
car.zh: 我爸爸开一辆红色汽车去上班。

train.en: We took a fast train to visit my grandma in the next city.
train.zh: 我们坐了一趟快速列车去隔壁城市看望奶奶。

city.en: My family moved to a big city with many tall buildings.
city.zh: 我们家搬到了一个有很多高楼的大城市。

town.en: Our small town has a nice park and a library.
town.zh: 我们的小镇上有一个漂亮的公园和图书馆。

ship.en: The big ship sailed across the ocean for three days.
ship.zh: 那艘大船在海上航行了三天。

plane.en: We saw a plane flying very low over our school.
plane.zh: 我们看到一架飞机飞得很低，掠过我们的学校。

sky.en: The sky turned orange and pink before the sun set.
sky.zh: 太阳落山前，天空变成了橙色和粉色。

place.en: This is my favorite place to read books after school.
place.zh: 这是我放学后最喜欢看书的地方。

near.en: The supermarket is near my house, so I can walk there.
near.zh: 超市在我家附近，所以我可以走路过去。

travel.en: We will travel by bus to the mountain village next summer.
travel.zh: 明年夏天我们将乘公交车去那个山村旅行。

way.en: One good way to learn English is to sing songs.
way.zh: 学英语的一个好方法是唱歌。

cold.en: Please wear a warm coat because it is very cold outside.
cold.zh: 外面很冷，请穿上一件暖和的外套。

or.en: Do you want to play soccer or basketball after class?
or.zh: 下课后你想踢足球还是打篮球？

enjoy.en: I enjoy playing football with my friends after school.
enjoy.zh: 我喜欢放学后和朋友们一起踢足球。

diary.en: My sister writes in her diary every night before bed.
diary.zh: 我姐姐每晚睡觉前都会写日记。

teacher.en: Our teacher gave us a big smile when we answered correctly.
teacher.zh: 我们回答正确时，老师给了我们一个大大的微笑。

taste.en: This apple tastes sweet and juicy, just like candy.
taste.zh: 这个苹果尝起来又甜又多汁，就像糖果一样。

ice cream.en: On hot days, I love to eat ice cream in the park.
ice cream.zh: 在炎热的日子里，我喜欢在公园里吃冰淇淋。

real.en: The toy snake looks so real that my mom screamed.
real.zh: 这只玩具蛇看起来太逼真了，我妈妈都尖叫了。

later.en: We can play hide-and-seek later after you finish your homework.
later.zh: 等你做完作业后，我们可以玩捉迷藏。

coat.en: Don't forget your coat; it's cold and windy outside today.
coat.zh: 别忘了你的外套；今天外面又冷又刮风。

turn.en: Please turn your chair around and face the blackboard.
turn.zh: 请把你的椅子转过来，面向黑板。

turn on.en: Can you turn on the lamp? It's too dark to read here.
turn on.zh: 你能打开台灯吗？这里太暗了，没法看书。

TV.en: My dad watches the news on TV after dinner every day.
TV.zh: 我爸爸每天晚饭后都会在电视上看新闻。

report.en: The weather report says it will rain tomorrow, so bring an umbrella.
report.zh: 天气预报说明天会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

left.en: She looked left and right before crossing the street.
left.zh: 她在过马路前向左和向右看了看。

straight.en: Walk straight for two blocks, then you will see the park.
straight.zh: 直走两个街区，你就会看到公园。

library.en: I borrowed a funny storybook from the school library.
library.zh: 我从学校图书馆借了一本有趣的故事书。

centre.en: There is a new shopping centre near our house.
centre.zh: 我们家附近有一个新的购物中心。

cinema.en: We watched a cartoon movie at the cinema last Saturday.
cinema.zh: 上周六我们在电影院看了一部卡通电影。

hospital.en: My uncle works as a doctor in a big hospital.
hospital.zh: 我叔叔在一家大医院当医生。

supermarket.en: Mom bought apples and milk at the supermarket this morning.
supermarket.zh: 妈妈今天早上在超市买了苹果和牛奶。

museum.en: Our class visited the science museum and saw dinosaur bones.
museum.zh: 我们班参观了科学博物馆，看到了恐龙骨骼。

tomorrow.en: We will have a spelling test tomorrow, so I need to study.
tomorrow.zh: 明天我们有一个拼写测试，所以我需要学习。

woman.en: The woman in the red dress is my aunt from Canada.
woman.zh: 穿红裙子的那位女士是我从加拿大来的阿姨。

wish.en: My birthday wish is to get a new bicycle this year.
wish.zh: 我的生日愿望是今年得到一辆新自行车。

step.en: Take one step forward and you will see the hidden treasure.
step.zh: 向前走一步，你就会看到隐藏的宝藏。

own.en: I have my own small garden with pretty flowers.
own.zh: 我有自己的小花园，里面种着美丽的花。

on one’s own.en: She finished the puzzle on her own without any help.
on one’s own.zh: 她独自完成了拼图，没有要任何帮助。

cross.en: Please cross the street only at the zebra crossing.
cross.zh: 请只在斑马线处横穿街道。

careful.en: Be careful when you carry the glass of water.

be careful.en: Be careful! The floor is wet after the rain.

underground.en: The subway train runs underground through the city.
underground.zh: 地铁列车在地下穿过城市。

picnic.en: We will have a picnic in the park this Saturday.
picnic.zh: 这周六我们将在公园里野餐。

minute.en: The pizza will be ready in just one minute.
minute.zh: 披萨只要一分钟就好了。

wear.en: I wear my red coat when it is cold outside.
wear.zh: 外面冷的时候我穿我的红外套。

live.en: My grandparents live in a small house near the lake.
live.zh: 我的祖父母住在湖边的一座小房子里。

away.en: The school is two blocks away from my home.
away.zh: 学校离我家有两个街区远。

truck.en: A big truck delivers fresh fruit to our store every morning.
truck.zh: 一辆大卡车每天早上给我们商店送新鲜水果。

bamboo.en: The panda eats fresh bamboo leaves every morning.
bamboo.zh: 熊猫每天早上吃新鲜的竹叶。

bike.en: My dad rides a red bike to the park.
bike.zh: 我爸爸骑着一辆红色自行车去公园。

ring.en: The school bell will ring at twelve o'clock.
ring.zh: 学校的铃会在十二点鸣响。

beep.en: The bus driver makes the horn beep twice.
beep.zh: 公交车司机让喇叭鸣响两次。

subway.en: We take the subway to visit our grandma.
subway.zh: 我们坐地铁去看望奶奶。

whoosh.en: The toy car goes whoosh down the slide.
whoosh.zh: 玩具车呼呼地从滑梯上滑下来。

tram.en: The old tram moves slowly along the street.
tram.zh: 老式有轨电车沿着街道缓慢行驶。

chug.en: The little train chug chug up the hill.
chug.zh: 小火车突突地爬上小山丘。

wheel.en: One wheel on my bicycle is flat.
wheel.zh: 我自行车的一个车轮没气了。
